note: Two pages, three centred columns with script-font section headings. The hardest structure in the corpus: Fried Rice / Lo Mein / Pad Thai / Pan-fried Noodles / Mei Fun / Chow Fun each list sub-items printed only as 'Choice of Chicken, Beef, Shrimp, OR Roast Pork', 'House', 'Vegetable' — the dish is only identifiable WITH its section. Those carry aliases. The PDF text layer scrambles which description belongs to which noodle dish (Mei Fun/Chow Fun swapped), so pairings were taken from the rendered page, wording from the text layer.
